On top of the crimes that police decide to include in the Ripper investigation, murders and attempted murders with a clear link to the killer are discarded and left unsolved. programme.desc: 1/8. Noughties UK indie music was iconic, fashionable and thrilling. Ep 1 takes us back to Year Zero (aka 2001), when a foreign band invasion ignited and inspired this nation's youth.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of... Indie Sleaze

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of... Indie Sleaze

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of... Indie Sleaze

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of... Indie Sleaze

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of... Indie Sleaze
programme.desc: 6/8. The UK indie guitar music scene hits the tabloids. This red top frenzy builds to a messy crescendo that includes phone hacking, divorce, band break-ups, and a devastating fatality.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of... Indie Sleaze
programme.desc: 7/8. Just six action-packed years after the start of the UK indie sleaze music scene, The Word magazine coins the derisory term "Landfill Indie", turning the entire genre into a joke.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of... Indie Sleaze
programme.desc: 8/8. So here we are, twenty years on... the UK Indie Explosion holds a fascination for those audiences too young to have experienced it firsthand.
